SNIG2025.title: Snigirevsky et al.2025 Two new reconstructions of Archaeopteris trees
SNIG2025.note: Primary full text read, particularly pp41–44 and Fig9. Actual Fig9 pixels inspected: published low-tree reconstruction has broad paddle leaves, branching woody trunk and crown. It is a copyrighted reconstruction, NOT a complete fossil. Authors explicitly retain copyright to Figs9/10. Consult-only, no source pixels/meshes incorporated or redistributed.

RIGA2011.title: Gonzalez Riga2011 Speeds and stance of titanosaur sauropods: Titanopodus tracks
RIGA2011.note: Original researcher primary text pp282–284, actual Fig2 map and Fig3A-C field photos and outline personally inspected. Small asymmetric crescent manus, larger pes and wide gauge; no producer genus identification. Supports same trace site as planned2009 source, whose publisher page403 and indexed abstract only. Consult-only; no redistribution or incorporation. An earlier image filename sauropod-fig2.png actually contains printedp282 text, not a figure; it is retained but not used as figure evidence.

HWANG2002.title: Hwang et al.2002 New pterosaur tracks from Late Cretaceous Uhangri Formation
HWANG2002.note: Primary full article, diagnosis and description pp423–424, measurements p425, Fig6 p427 photos/map personally inspected. RUMMY2021.title: Rummy, Halaclar and Chen2021 exceptionally preserved spiral coprolites, Tsagan-Tsab Formation
RUMMY2021.note: Primary text Systematic Ichnology and actual Fig2 O-R and other specimens personally inspected. Solid closely joined coiled masses, distinct ends, variable shallow/deep sulci; not loose cords. Used as explicitly documented source substitution for full morphology. Article states CC BY4.0 including images unless otherwise credited; nevertheless consult-only with no pixels incorporated or redistributed.
